name: Wind Blast
doc: Wind Blast (Thrustaevis' enemy attack; the act family, Drain's master): once its children are gone the actor pools, then one emitter per action - its sound, the wind's actor system, the master's release, the damage of its targets. Its parts are the port's code (FFNx mag029_wind_blast.cpp) run on the program's memory.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions and uses this memory.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs (its tasks the port's, its parts spawned by them): its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

act.doc: Drain's master in the act family's form: once its children are gone the actor pools carved from the arena top and cleared; the actor counters cleared every tick

parts.title: Emitter
parts.doc: One per action: its sound, the master's release, the damage of its targets

parts.title: Actor system
parts.doc: The wind's actor system (its actor data the exe's)

params.label: Release tick
params.doc: The master may start the next action at this tick

params.label: Damage tick
params.doc: The damage of every target of its action from this tick

tasks.doc: One per action: the module's own emitter (the port's task): its sound, the actor system, the master's release, the damage of its targets.

not_editable.label: Actor data
not_editable.doc: The actor system's data (exe data, relocated once by 0x87A150)
